illustration.note: All initial temperature, capacities, loss conductances and plotting choices are arbitrary analyst-selected sensitivities. They are NOT measured, fitted, sourced heater properties, confidence bounds, probable warm-up times, or operating recommendations. Assume one lumped temperature, constant capacity, rating-derived constant resistance, constant ambient, linear total heat loss and no sensor lag. Actual radiation, support conduction, mounting, sand moisture and heater internals can violate these assumptions.
